name: Mihon Harmony Preview v0.21.2-harmony-preview.30
body:
基于 [Mihon v0.21.2](https://github.com/mihonapp/mihon/releases/tag/v0.21.2) 的非官方 HarmonyOS / 卓易通 兼容构建 (nightly 构建类型)。

## 本构建包含的补丁

- `0001-downloads-rename-fallback-for-saf-without-renamedocument.patch`: downloads: fall back to copy+delete when SAF renameDocument is unsupported
- `0002-updater-use-harmony-fork-releases.patch`: updater: check this fork's GitHub releases for -harmony-preview builds
- `0003-downloads-cbz-temp-in-private-cache.patch`: downloads: keep CBZ temp files in the private cache, tolerate stale archives
- `0005-downloads-background-keep-alive-silent-audio.patch`: downloads: keep the process alive in the background on HarmonyOS (silent audio + wake lock)
- `0006-downloads-notification-speed-and-progress.patch`: downloads: Animeko-style progress notification with speed and progress
- `0007-updater-delete-installed-apk.patch`: updater: delete the installed update APK at startup
- `0008-updater-release-mirror.patch`: updater: read the release list from the repo-branch mirror first
- `0010-downloads-finalize-with-fewer-saf-copies-and-error-reasons.patch`: downloads: finish chapters with fewer SAF copies and show why a download failed
- `0011-downloads-never-skip-silently-reuse-or-replace-leftover-folders.patch`: downloads: never drop a chapter silently; reuse or replace folders left on disk
- `0012-crash-log-filter-harmony-noise-and-keep-app-log.patch`: =?UTF-8?q?crash=20log:=20filter=20=E5=8D=93?= =?UTF-8?q?=E6=98=93=E9=80=9A=20graphics=20noise=20and=20keep=20the=20app'?= =?UTF-8?q?s=20own=20log=20lines?=
- `0013-downloads-retried-failed-chapters-are-not-skipped.patch`: downloads: do not report a retried failed chapter as "already in the queue"
- `0014-library-panorama-comfortable-grid-display-mode.patch`: library: add a panorama comfortable grid display mode (wide covers, staggered layout)
- `0015-library-panorama-compact-grid-display-mode.patch`: library: add a panorama compact grid display mode
- `0016-presentation-staggered-fast-scroller-steady-thumb.patch`: presentation: keep the staggered fast scroller thumb steady
- `0017-updater-pick-highest-harmony-version.patch`: updater: pick the highest harmony version instead of the first listed
- `0018-library-panorama-stable-cell-shapes.patch`: library: keep panorama cell shapes stable while scrolling
- `0019-library-panorama-settle-debounce-browse-prefetch.patch`: library: wait for the panorama grid to really stop and learn browse shapes ahead
- `0020-presentation-staggered-scroller-stable-thumb.patch`: presentation: keep the staggered fast-scroll thumb from stepping back once a row
- `0021-presentation-panorama-masonry-reading-order.patch`: presentation: lay panorama cells left to right unless a lane is recessed by half
- `0022-updater-retry-and-resume-the-update-download.patch`: updater: retry and resume the update download
- `0023-presentation-panorama-auto-columns-span.patch`: presentation: panorama auto columns fit book covers and wide covers span two lanes
- `0024-presentation-panorama-scroll-anchor-by-key.patch`: presentation: panorama grid saves its scroll anchor by key
- `0025-presentation-panorama-layout-epoch.patch`: presentation: panorama layout skips per-item work while content is unchanged
- `0026-library-panorama-cover-shapes-versioned.patch`: library: panorama cover shapes notify per version, not per map read
- `0027-presentation-fast-scroller-hold-grab.patch`: presentation: fast scroller thumb stays grabbed while pressed
- `0028-presentation-panorama-tiered-auto-columns.patch`: presentation: panorama auto columns widen on large windows
- `0029-presentation-fast-scroller-snapshotflow.patch`: presentation: fast scroller follows scroll without restarting per frame
- `0030-presentation-panorama-shaped-columns.patch`: presentation: panorama auto columns follow the shelf's dominant cover shape
- `0031-library-panorama-shape-mode.patch`: library: panorama grids pick tall or wide columns from committed cover shapes
- `0032-presentation-fast-scroller-thumb-hitbox.patch`: presentation: fast scroller hit box stays on the drawn thumb
- `0033-presentation-panorama-scroll-trace.patch`: presentation: panorama scroll trace in the crash log dump
- `0034-presentation-panorama-exact-scroll-delta.patch`: presentation: panorama scroll reports the exact delta it applied
- `0035-presentation-fast-scroller-hold-to-grab.patch`: presentation: fast scroller grabs on the thumb or on a hold beside it
- `0036-app-scroll-performance-recorder.patch`: app: scroll performance recorder with a share button
- `0037-app-scroll-recorder-drop-counts-and-toggles.patch`: app: scroll recorder counts dropped reports, stages and cover loads
- `0038-presentation-panorama-defer-shapes-while-scrolling.patch`: presentation: panorama shapes learnt while scrolling wait for the grid to settle
- `0039-presentation-panorama-prefetch-cover-headers.patch`: presentation: browse panorama prefetch reads cover headers ahead of the viewport
- `0040-presentation-panorama-masonry-append-pages.patch`: presentation: panorama masonry appends pages without a full relayout
- `0041-app-scroll-recorder-lighter-sampler-and-composed-counts.patch`: app: scroll recorder samples threads less often and counts composed cells
- `0042-presentation-panorama-placeholder-follows-shelf.patch`: presentation: panorama placeholders follow the shelf and placed cells keep their slot
- `0043-presentation-auto-columns-expanded-windows.patch`: presentation: automatic columns widen cells on expanded windows
- `0044-presentation-browse-cells-skip-paging-reads.patch`: presentation: browse cells skip per-frame paging reads
- `0045-browse-panorama-cover-size-probe.patch`: browse: panorama pages read cover sizes before they are shown
- `0046-presentation-panorama-width-stable-navigation.patch`: presentation: keep panorama columns stable while navigation collapses
- `0047-presentation-compact-scroll-navigation.patch`: presentation: use compact navigation and reveal it on reverse scrolling
- `0048-presentation-immersive-browsing-chrome.patch`: presentation: collapse complete browsing headers and reveal navigation immediately
- `0049-presentation-synchronized-floating-navigation.patch`: presentation: synchronize floating navigation without moving browsing content
- `0050-presentation-gesture-latched-navigation.patch`: presentation: stabilize navigation gestures and keep scrollers inside safe tracks
- `0051-presentation-glass-navigation-polish.patch`: presentation: polish compact glass navigation and scroll geometry
- `0052-presentation-inline-tabs-refresh-layer.patch`: presentation: refine inline navigation and translucent edge browsing
- `0053-reader-contained-mode-notice.patch`: reader: keep reading mode notices inside the reader window
- `0054-ui-refresh-window-insets.patch`: ui: refresh edge-to-edge insets after window changes
- `0055-presentation-reveal-navigation-at-end.patch`: presentation: reveal floating navigation at the list end
- `0056-presentation-preserve-navigation-scroll-source.patch`: presentation: preserve navigation scroll source and single-line badges
- `0057-ui-history-cards-and-pinned-more-glass.patch`: ui: show dated history cards and pin glass navigation on More
- `0058-updater-refresh-manual-checks.patch`: updater: fetch fresh release metadata for manual checks
- `0059-ui-lazy-timelines-and-window-state.patch`: ui: virtualize history and updates and preserve fold navigation state
- `0060-ui-timeline-panorama-and-clock.patch`: ui: align timeline panorama spans and compact 24-hour actions
- `0061-ui-browsing-side-insets-and-tabs.patch`: ui: remove browsing cutout gutter and animate category indicator
- `0062-ui-floating-capsule-and-fast-swipes.patch`: ui: float glass navigation and stabilize repeated fast upward swipes
- `0063-test-capsule-badge-semantics.patch`: test: locate capsule badge in unmerged semantics tree
- `0064-ui-text-glass-and-bidirectional-fast-swipes.patch`: ui: rebuild text-only refractive glass navigation and hide on fast return swipes
- `0065-ui-glass-renderer-compatibility.patch`: fix: support legacy shader sampling and clear completed fling speed
- `0066-ui-neutral-glass-text-and-render-test.patch`: ui: keep glass text neutral and enable native kernel pixel validation
- `0067-ui-glass-array-uniforms.patch`: fix: bind glass shader dimensions through array uniforms
- `0068-ui-capsule-type-spacing-and-gesture-sensitivity.patch`: fix(ui): soften navigation hiding and use solid compact capsule labels
- `0069-ui-capsule-fit-optics-and-touch.patch`: fix(ui): fit capsule corners and own its full touch surface
- `0070-ui-capsule-drag-count.patch`: test(ui): count the initial capsule tap before drag assertions
- `0071-ui-stop-hidden-glass-capture.patch`: perf(ui): stop glass backdrop capture while navigation is fully hidden
- `0072-ui-capsule-feedback-symmetry-and-legibility.patch`: fix(ui): balance capsule touch feedback symmetry and legibility
- `0073-ui-soft-glass-edges-and-brighter-contact.patch`: fix(ui): soften glass edges and brighten the touch core
- `0074-ui-frame-budgeted-panorama-and-scroll-diagnostics.patch`: perf(ui): defer panorama prefetch and gate scroller capture
- `0075-test-current-thumb-grab-boundary.patch`: test(ui): cover the current thumb grab and flick boundaries
- `0076-ui-window-capture-lifetime-and-light-recorder.patch`: fix(ui): renew window captures and lighten scroll recording
- `0077-test-render-before-layer-lifetime-assertions.patch`: test(ui): render the capture before asserting layer lifetime
- `0078-ui-adaptive-window-continuity-and-soft-press-light.patch`: fix(ui): retain adaptive main windows and soften press light

## 安装说明

- 下载 `mihon-v0.21.2-harmony-preview.30-arm64-v8a.apk`（华为设备均为 arm64）。
- 包名为 `app.mihon.debug`，与官方正式版 `app.mihon` 是两个独立应用，可以共存；harmony-preview 版本之间可直接覆盖安装。
- 设置 → 高级 → 扩展安装器 选「Private」，扩展会装进 App 自己的目录，不再受卓易通安装限制。
- 应用内更新会检查本仓库的 Release，而不是官方更新服务器。
- 建议开启 设置 → 下载 →「保存为 CBZ」：目录模式下下载中的图片会被鸿蒙图库索引。

- 滑动性能与格式4诊断：全景仅同步处理可见卡片，屏幕外预加载交由Compose按帧预算调度；清理过期请求，减少返回书架和滑动时的集中工作。
